headline: Volume has held flat while easy-run HR keeps trending down, so the "detraining" strain flag misreads a genuine consolidation.
confidence_reasons: Multiple data sources active in last 3 days
summary:
Your load hasn't dropped in any way that matters — four-week volume is essentially level with the prior block and the running streak is intact at its all-time best. What has changed is efficiency: easy-run HR continues to sit meaningfully lower on comparable efforts than it did a period ago. That's the through-line from the past week, and it holds again today. Read the two figures together and the picture is a base that's getting more economical at the same workload, not one that's shrinking.

The Polar strain:tolerance ratio flags DETRAINING, but treat that as one unvalidated signal in its own unit rather than a verdict. Your 28-day tolerance is anchored by a higher-load stretch that included last week's hard tempo, so a quieter recent seven days will mechanically pull the ratio down — that's arithmetic, not lost fitness, especially set against flat volume and a strength block that's doubled its frequency. If it kept falling while HR started drifting up and pace slipped, that would be worth acting on. None of that is happening.

Strength is the quietly notable line: nine sessions in four weeks is a real step up in frequency, and it's holding alongside the running rather than displacing it. With the crossing under a month out, that durability base is well-timed.
watch_items: Whether the strain ratio recovers on its own once the next quality or longer session lands, confirming it was a rolling-average artefact rather than a real dip.
Whether pack-loaded or back-to-back running finally appears, given the self-supported crossing is now inside a month and hasn't yet shown up in the data.
Whether per-run elevation starts climbing to rehearse the sustained border-section terrain.
Sleep remains erratic across tracked nights, with one long night offsetting several short ones — worth watching whether it steadies as specific durability work ramps.

evidence_items.text: ▼ Easy-run HR averaging 143 bpm vs 153 bpm prior period (comparable-effort runs, 9 vs 8 runs)
▼ Strain:tolerance ratio 0.73 (DETRAINING) (strain 45, tolerance 61); sleep averaging 7h40m over the same period
▲ 4-week volume 140 km vs 137 km prior block (+2%)
